# GitHub Copilot instructions

This is the special public GitHub profile repository for `Charlie-Wang-03`.

Before proposing substantial edits, read the root `AGENTS.md` and
`MAINTENANCE.md`. Treat `AGENTS.md` as the canonical maintenance policy.

Key constraints:

- verify current GitHub facts before changing public claims;
- never surface private-repository information without explicit approval;
- keep English and Simplified Chinese profile facts aligned;
- preserve the current restrained visual style unless redesign is requested;
- keep selected projects curated and open-source contributions compact;
- prefer short-lived branch → PR → Markdown CI → squash merge;
- do not weaken repository protection or governance.
